props.gloss_en: [covering the blood applies] to consecrated animals -- which the mishna denies
a koy is not slaughtered on a festival, and if he slaughtered it, one does not cover its blood
R' Zeira: one who slaughters must put earth below and earth above
R' Zeira's source: 'and cover it in earth' (Lev 17:13) -- not 'earth' but 'in earth'
entertained: consecrated birds are exempt because earth cannot be put beneath their blood [on the altar], per R' Zeira's rule
if he puts earth [on the altar] and nullifies it, he adds to the structure -- and it is written 'all is in writing from the hand of the Lord' (I Chr 28:19)
if he does not nullify it, it is an interposition [between blood and altar]
R' Yonatan b. Yosef: slaughtered a chaya then a behema -- exempt from covering; a behema then a chaya -- obligated to cover
R' Zeira: whatever is fit for mixing, mixing does not hold it up; whatever is not fit for mixing, mixing holds it up
the mishna (87b): blood that spurted and blood on the knife -- one is obligated to cover
for altar consecrations, indeed [he would scrape and cover]; here [the mishna] deals with consecrations for Temple maintenance
[a slaughtered bird cannot be redeemed:] we require standing and valuing
R' Meir: all [consecrations, Temple-maintenance included] were included in standing and valuing
R' Meir: a slaughter that is not fit [to permit] is called slaughter
R' Shimon: a slaughter that is not fit is not called slaughter
R' Shimon: [Temple-maintenance consecrations] were not included in standing and valuing
reading: the mishna follows R' Meir
reading: the mishna follows R' Shimon
Rav Yosef: it is Rebbi, taking it according to [different] tannaim -- on unfit slaughter he holds like R' Shimon, on standing and valuing like R' Meir
here it is different, for the verse says 'and he shall pour out and cover' -- one lacking only pouring and covering; excluded is this, which lacks pouring, redemption and covering
now that you have come to this, even say altar consecrations -- excluded is this, which lacks pouring, scraping and covering
Yaakov Mina'a: we hold that the chaya is included in behema for the [kashrut] signs
Yaakov Mina'a: say also that behema is included in chaya for covering
Rava: against you the verse says 'you shall pour it on the ground like water' (Deut 12:24) -- as water needs no covering, this too needs no covering
the verse says 'but a spring or a cistern, a gathering of water, shall be pure' (Lev 11:36) -- these yes, anything else no [so blood does not purify]
two exclusions are written: 'a spring of water' and 'a cistern of water'
three exclusions are written: 'a spring of water', 'a cistern of water', 'a gathering of water'
the baraita: 'who traps' -- what of those already trapped of themselves, like geese and chickens? 'a trapping' -- in any case
the baraita: why 'who traps'? the Torah taught proper conduct -- a person should eat meat only with such preparation
the baraita: 'when the Lord your God expands your border' (Deut 12:20) -- the Torah taught that a person should eat meat only from appetite
the baraita: might one buy [meat] from the market and eat? 'and you shall slaughter of your herd and your flock' (Deut 12:21)
the baraita: might he slaughter all his herd and eat? 'of your herd' -- and not all your herd; 'of your flock' -- and not all your flock
R' Elazar ben Azarya: one who has a maneh buys a litra of vegetables for his pot; ten maneh, a litra of fish; fifty maneh, a litra of meat; a hundred maneh, a pot is set for him every day
and the others [who eat no meat daily] -- when? from Shabbat eve to Shabbat eve
Rav: we must be concerned for the words of the elder
R' Yochanan: Abba was of a family of the healthy
R' Yochanan: but such as us -- one who has a peruta in his purse should run it to the shopkeeper
Rav Nachman: such as us borrow and eat
'lambs for your clothing' (Prov 27:26) -- from the shearing of lambs let your clothing be
'and goats the price of a field' -- a person should always sell a field and buy goats, and not sell goats and buy a field
'and goats' milk enough' -- it suffices a person to be sustained by the milk of the kids and lambs in his house
'for your bread, for the bread of your house' (Prov 27:27) -- your bread comes before the bread of your house
Mar Zutra b. Rav Nachman: 'and life for your maidens' -- give life to your youths; from here the Torah taught that a person should not accustom his son to meat and wine
R' Yochanan: one who wishes to become rich should engage in small cattle
Rav Chisda: what is 'and the ashterot of your flock' (Deut 7:13)? that they enrich their owners
R' Yochanan: [better] a cup of charashin, and not a cup of lukewarm water
and this is only in metal vessels; in earthenware we have no [problem]
and in metal vessels too, we said it only where he did not cast spices into them; if he cast spices, we have no [problem]
and where he did not cast spices too, we said it only where it was not boiled; if boiled, we have no [problem]
R' Yochanan: one whose father left him money and who wishes to lose it -- let him wear linen, use glass vessels, and hire workers and not sit with them
linen -- Roman linen; glass -- white glass; workers unsupervised -- with oxen, whose damage is great

what is 'good is the man who is gracious and lends, who orders his affairs with justice' (Ps 112:5)? a person should always eat and drink less than his means, dress and cover himself within his means, and honour his wife and children beyond his means -- for they depend on him, and he depends on the One who spoke and the world came to be
Rav Eina: one who slaughters for a sick person on Shabbat is obligated to cover
Rabba: [Rav Eina] spoke in error -- one who slaughters for a sick person on Shabbat does not cover; that is the 'certain case of covering that does not override Shabbat'
R' Yosei: circumcision -- its certain case overrides Shabbat
R' Yosei: circumcision -- its doubtful case does not override Yom Tov
R' Yosei: covering -- its certain case does not override Shabbat
the Sages: shofar-blowing in the provinces -- its certain case does not override Shabbat
the Sages: shofar-blowing -- its doubtful case overrides Yom Tov
R' Elazar HaKappar: what of circumcision? it does not apply on Yom Tov nights; will you say [the same] of covering, which applies on Yom Tov nights?
rather: what of circumcision? it does not apply at night as by day; will you say [the same] of covering, which applies at night as by day?
R' Chiya: I have no reply against them [among them R' Yosei's kal vachomer]
R' Abba: this is one of the things of which R' Chiya said 'I have no reply', and R' Elazar HaKappar beRibbi gave a reply
reading: the shofar's doubt is whether the day is weekday or Yom Tov
reading: the shofar's doubt is whether [the blower] is a man or a woman
R' Yosei follows his own reasoning, for he holds a certain woman may also blow
the baraita: the sons of Israel lean [on the offering], and the daughters of Israel do not
R' Yosei and R' Shimon: women lean optionally
Ravina: what of shofar? its certain case overrides Shabbat in the Temple; will you say [the same] of covering, which [overrides Shabbat] nowhere?

schemas.gloss_en: אמר קרא חיה או עוף -- מה חיה אינה קדש, אף עוף אינו קדש: as the chaya [of the covering verse] is not consecrated, so the bird is not consecrated
אי מה חיה שאין במינו קדש, אף עוף שאין במינו קדש -- אוציא תורין ובני יונה, שיש במינן קדש: the proposed extension excluding even unconsecrated turtledoves and pigeons

grounds.gloss_en: לא, כחיה -- מה חיה לא חלקת בה, אף עוף לא תחלוק בו: no -- like the chaya, in which you made no division [by kind], make none in the bird

schemas.gloss_en: ומה מילה שודאה דוחה שבת אין ספיקה דוחה יום טוב, כסוי שאין ודאו דוחה שבת אינו דין שאין ספקו דוחה יום טוב: if circumcision, whose certain case overrides Shabbat, has a doubtful case that does not override Yom Tov, then covering, whose certain case does not override Shabbat, surely has a doubtful case [the koy] that does not override Yom Tov

grounds.gloss_en: אמר לו (84b.7; אמרו לו, 84b.13): תקיעת שופר בגבולים תוכיח, שאין ודאה דוחה שבת וספיקה דוחה יום טוב -- the Sages' counterexample. The stam asks מאי ספיקה and answers ספק איש ספק אשה (frame f_mai_sfeika)

answered_by.gloss_en: ורבי יוסי לטעמיה, דאמר אשה ודאית נמי תקעה -- for R' Yosei even a certain woman may blow, so the doubtful case overrides nothing (= p_ry_isha_vadait_tokaat)
ולמאי דקאמרי רבנן נמי אית ליה פירכא: מה לתקיעת שופר שכן ודאה דוחה שבת במקדש, תאמר בכסוי דליתיה כלל -- even on the Sages' view the counterexample is refuted (= p_shofar_docheh_shabbat_bamikdash)

grounds.gloss_en: השיב רבי אלעזר הקפר בריבי תשובה: מה למילה שכן אינה נוהגת בלילי ימים טובים, תאמר בכסוי שנוהג בלילי ימים טובים -- reread by the stam at 85a.6: שכן אינה נוהגת בלילות כבימים. Unanswered; R' Abba: R' Chiya had no reply, R' Elazar HaKappar replied

supports.gloss_en: כדרבי זירא -- what cannot be done properly [earth below] is a bar, as with mixing
מכאן אמר רבי אלעזר בן עזריה -- from 'of your herd, and not all your herd'
קתני מיהת כסוי שאין ודאו דוחה שבת -- מאי ודאו דכסוי דלא דחי שבת? לאו השוחט לחולה בשבת?

deflected_by.gloss_en: ודלמא דעבר ושחט? -- perhaps the baraita's certain case is one who transgressed and slaughtered

refuted_by.gloss_en: דומיא דמילה: מה מילה ברשות, אף כסוי נמי ברשות -- like circumcision, done with permission

supports.gloss_en: דתניא: בני ישראל סומכין ולא בנות ישראל סומכות; רבי יוסי ורבי שמעון אומרים נשים סומכות רשות

frames.gloss_en: וכמאן? -- whose is the mishna, read as speaking of Temple-maintenance consecrations that cannot be redeemed once slaughtered?

alternatives.gloss_en: R' Meir, who includes them in standing and valuing

eliminated_by.gloss_en: האמר שחיטה שאינה ראויה שמה שחיטה -- but he says unfit slaughter is slaughter, so it would be covered

alternatives.gloss_en: R' Shimon, for whom unfit slaughter is not slaughter

eliminated_by.gloss_en: האמר לא היו בכלל העמדה והערכה -- but he says they were not included, so let them be redeemed and covered

rebuffed_by.gloss_en: ואיבעית אימא כולה רבי שמעון היא, ושאני הכא דאמר קרא ושפך וכסה -- excluded is what lacks pouring, redemption and covering (= p_veshafach_vechisa_mechusar_pidyon)

alternatives.gloss_en: Rav Yosef: Rebbi, like R' Shimon on unfit slaughter and like R' Meir on standing and valuing

frames.gloss_en: מאי ספיקה? -- what is the shofar's 'doubtful case' that overrides Yom Tov?

alternatives.gloss_en: a doubt whether the day is weekday or Yom Tov

eliminated_by.gloss_en: השתא ודאי יום טוב דחיא, ספק יום טוב ספק חול מיבעיא? -- it overrides a certain Yom Tov; need a doubtful one be said?

alternatives.gloss_en: a doubt whether the blower is a man or a woman

objections.gloss_en: נהי דלמטה לא אפשר, למעלה אפשר, ליעביד כסוי! מי לא תניא ... בהמה ואחר כך חיה חייב לכסות -- granted below is impossible, above is possible; covering applies even without earth beneath

answered_by.gloss_en: כדרבי זירא: כל הראוי לבילה אין בילה מעכבת בו, וכל שאינו ראוי לבילה בילה מעכבת בו (= p_rz_ein_bila_meakevet)

objections.gloss_en: וליגרריה וליכסייה? מי לא תנן דם הניתז ושעל הסכין חייב לכסות -- אלמא דגריר ומכסי ליה, הכא נמי נגרור ונכסי ליה

answered_by.gloss_en: אי בקדשי מזבח הכי נמי, הכא במאי עסקינן בקדשי בדק הבית -- concedes altar consecrations; the mishna is re-read (= p_okimta_bedek_habayit)
והשתא דאתית להכי, אפילו תימא קדשי מזבח -- יצא זה שמחוסר שפיכה גרירה וכסוי (= p_veshafach_vechisa_mechusar_gerira)

objections.gloss_en: וליפרקינהו וליכסינהו? -- let them be redeemed [after slaughter] and their blood covered
אמר ליה: עליך אמר קרא על הארץ תשפכנו כמים -- the verse itself compares the behema's blood to water, which needs no covering
אלא מעתה, יטבילו בו? -- if the blood is like water, let impure things be immersed in it

answered_by.gloss_en: אך מעין ובור מקוה מים יהיה טהור -- הני אין, מידי אחרינא לא (= p_ach_mayan_hanei_in)

objections.gloss_en: ואימא הני מילי למעוטי שאר משקין דלא איקרו מים, אבל דם דאיקרי מים הכי נמי -- the exclusion may be only of liquids not called water

answered_by.gloss_en: תרי מיעוטי כתיבי: מעין מים, ובור מים (= p_trei_miutei)

objections.gloss_en: אימא אידי ואידי למעוטי שאר משקין, חד למעוטי זוחלין וחד למעוטי מכונסין -- both may exclude other liquids, one flowing and one gathered

answered_by.gloss_en: תלתא מיעוטי כתיבי: מעין מים, ובור מים, מקוה מים (= p_tlata_miutei)

objections.gloss_en: אשתומא קאמר ... דתניא: רבי יוסי אומר ... כסוי שאין ודאו דוחה שבת -- the baraita knows no certain covering that overrides Shabbat
בלילי ימים טובים הוא דלא נהגא, בשאר לילי נהגא? -- does circumcision then apply on other nights?

answered_by.gloss_en: אלא: מה למילה שכן אינה נוהגת בלילות כבימים (= p_mila_ein_noheget_balelot)
